models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Electronic Steering Column Lock not working
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Electronic Ignition Lock (D9) faulty
Electronic Steering Column Lock Control Module (J764) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Electronic Ignition Lock (D9)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Electronic Steering Column Lock Control Module (J764)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the VW Passat (3C), it might be possible to Değiştirin / Yenileyin: the Electronic Steering Column Lock (J764) separately from the entire steering column.
The Comfort Control Module (J393) houses the Immobilizer related Functions.  Depending on the  Comfort Control Module, it might be possible to reprogram it as opposed to replacing it with the ESCL replacement. Generally immobilizer repairs on the  VW Passat (3C) are performed at the VW Dealer using their GEKO system. Additional information about this system is found here: VW Passat (3C) Immobilizer
As of Feb. 2011 the ESCL is a recall on some NAR (US and Canadian) market vehicles. Contact your local dealer if the component has failed to see if this applies to the VIN in question.
